author: VenomousViper
body:
Hey,

So here's the deal, we need your suggestions on what should be added/removed from Teamspeak. Try and elaborate on your responses. Any feedback helps, however please only give serious responses and keep it appropriate. Contact Edans or Myself for any questions you may have. 

Thanks,
The TeamSpeak Development Team

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Strengthen the overall Policies of the TS. That includes Player Policies, Staff Policies, Etc. This idea will not make ts more strict if people are worried about that, but it will make ts a much clearer area to moderate and converse without BS bans and kicks to happen. Next I would suggest investing time into a TS training for mods so it is easier for staff to remember the rules and know how to act in a situation if needed. 

Remove the channel requirements. PPB were about to go on public matches and ask random people to join just for the channel.

replies.author: VenomousViper
replies.body:
Update: Thanks for the feedback, Seth and I have decided to lessen the requirments for a teamchat they are now: 

-At least 10 active players who are not banned.
-At least 10 logged scrimmages.
-10 Players with over 24 hours of ingame time (who are not banned).
-10 Players with atleast 2500 kills, or 100 objectives (who are not banned).
-Official consent (Atleast 2). (In the event that a Head of Teamspeak sees fit, we can approve/deny your request for a channel.)
-Failure to be active on your channel will result in a reconsideration of whether it should remain.
